notes.title: Player versus Player Beta announced for General Staff: Black Powder!
notes.content: [p]Early-backers of General Staff: Black Powder are cordially invited to participate in Player versus Player testing on Steam. If you are an early backer of this project and want to participate in this beta test, please send an email to BetaTester@RiverviewAI.com.[/p][p][/p][p]On a personal note, I just want to add, that in the ‘old days’ we used to have to pay people to be beta-testers. I can’t believe you want to be beta-testers. But, it’s one of the perks of being an early-backer; so welcome aboard![/p][p][/p][p]Primarily we’re going to be testing two things: first, any actual bugs in the code. That’s pretty obvious. But, we’re also going to be looking at the scenarios (the first four to be released are Quatre Bras, Ligny, Manassas Campaign and Antietam). Have we made any mistakes about unit placement? Strength? Problems with Leadership or Morale ratings? Did we get the historical accuracy right? Are our combat equations wrong? These are the things that we’ll need to hear back from you about.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for being so patient. Now the fun begins![/p]

notes.title: General Staff, What's Taking So Long?
notes.content:
Hello Wargamers!

There's been, understandably, a large number of questions regarding the delay in the game's release. 

The short and long answer is best written by the mastermind himself in this article.

[url=https://www.general-staff.com/why-this-game-is-taking-so-long/]>Click Here To Read Article<[/url]

Additionally, we are currently discussing test plans and release options. I will be working on the release packages while testing is being performed. This might not seem like much but discussing release options are a large leap in the initial release, finally! 

As always, feel free to reach out if you have any further questions!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Light at the end of the tunnel
notes.content:
Hello Wargamers!

We are working overtime to get the official Alpha release for testing! Things are finally wrapping up and coming to a head. 

We are working on some fixes and quality of life features and will officially announce the date for the Alpha release very soon!

Thank for hanging in there and being such a supportive community!

notes.title: Updates! Updates! Updates!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Wargamers! [/b]

DisKoBAT here, we know how much nobody likes being left in the dark, so we wanted get you guys some updates! 

The biggest thing to mention currently is that we are pushing to get some testing done on our end and an Alpha release to you, and I cannot express how grateful we are for your unbelievable patience! 

We do have some things that are setting us back some, I personally will be taking a few days off, I wish I could say for good reasons but a close family member is very ill and I will needing to be attending to them for a few days. No worries though, during this time Ezra will be working on a game engine unique bug that he consulted for help with. So all-in-all, we are still pushing to get a quality product out to you but within a reasonable time. 

We know how much the community has been waiting for a release and we are setting our sights on a quality product versus a fast product, and I think anyone can agree is preferred. 

The other side of the double edge sword is, yes, again a reward for how understanding this community has been, we're currently discussing release discounts and rewards! 

We cannot thank you enough! We wish everyone happy holidays and, well, keep on keepin' on!

notes.title: Editor Updates and Cloud Saves
notes.content:
Hello All,

I deployed several app updates through the night (thanks to [b]copious[/b] amounts of energy drinks) and from my testing it appears many of the community concerns have been addressed.

[list]
[*] All three Editor applications were cleaned/rebuilt from source code.
[*] The main depo that houses all the files was wiped and reloaded with all fresh files and folder structures.
[*] The launcher received a handful of small updates to allow my update for the auto path discovering code and Steam integrations.
[*] The uninstaller received some updates and should fully remove all files for clean installs.
[/list]
 
[b]Cloud Autosaves are now fully setup and tested to be working![/b]

The biggest advantage to that, if you uninstall or have a system crash, any custom maps, scenario, or army files you created will now install as well!

Thanks again for your patience while we iron out the kinks and expect some good feature upgrades soon!

notes.title: Updates! Updates! Updates!
notes.content:
Hello all,

Things have been a little nutty here with us all lately but we are still pushing forward to get some updates and improvements for you all. We know the air waves have been kind of silent and we cannot apologize enough. Life is fun, isn't it? 

We have editor updates ready to push for you guys to get many of the issues addressed for you. I will get those deployed ASAP and expect an update across your dash board within the next 24 hours. 

Updates and communication should be more frequent from now, and we have some big plans already in development with the Steam network.

Thanks again and hope you are all well!

notes.title: Game Paths and Installer Issues Addressed
notes.content:
[i][b]Hey Everyone![/b][/i]

We have been plugging away at the issues being reported with .exe paths, missing files, etc. 

With quite a few reworks it appears the issues have been resolved and will no longer be present in the latest update. 

Now with any software, not every edge-case can be accounted for but we are doing our best to account for them!

If you have any issues or questions please reach out to our support team at:
[url=Support@RiverviewAI.com]Support@RiverviewAI.com[/url]

Thank you!
